name: tamerlane-board
description: Tamerlane Board: Timur's 14th-century chess on an 11x10 board with giraffes, war engines and citadels, a data-driven move generator where every piece is a line of Betza-like notation, a piece lab with a mobility-based value estimate and engine-vs-engine balance tests, and a small alpha-beta engine in a Web Worker. Entirely client-side.
